title: Async job
description: A durable inference job (specs/52). Durable-first: long-running inference is a job, never a held-open request. Result by reference: the result is an artifact reference (result_ref), not an inline body. Circumvention control: durable jobs observe the same admission, capacity, fairshare, and owner-priority controls as synchronous inference and do not bypass them. `family` is additive: new family-aware submissions carry it, while persisted legacy jobs without it remain readable. Resumable: an interrupted job resumes from durable progress after a restart.

state.description: New producers emit succeeded for successful completion. completed is accepted only when reading legacy Protocol v1 job records and is normalized to succeeded before re-emission.

family.description: Additive runtime family from the specs/48 registry. Required for new family-aware inference submissions when runtime_families/1 is negotiated; absent means a legacy job and is never inferred from model names.

result_ref.description: Result by reference: artifact in the artifact cache model.
